description_en: A tapered round woven basket body with a tall fabric drawstring collar and single shoulder strap. Canonical front: the oval cane handle attachment and gathered fabric collar. Side view: a tapering cylindrical profile with strap hardware. Rear view: a continuous woven wall and second strap anchor. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A tapered round woven basket body with a tall fabric drawstring collar and single shoulder strap. Canonical front: the oval cane handle attachment and gathered fabric collar. Side view: a tapering cylindrical profile with strap hardware. Rear view: a continuous woven wall and second strap anchor. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
